relation_verdicts.detail: explicit labels must preserve which requirement remains active
family-wide retraction should over-retract the explicit-label case
ordinal target resolution must preserve first versus second
explicit-only resolution must fail closed on an underspecified pronoun
ambiguity-preserving resolution must retain multiple alternatives
speaker-owned reference should outperform nearest-only target selection
rescinding the outer notice must not automatically retract the inner quoted command
resumption should restore the suspended requirement
audit failure and success must produce different conditional states
contradiction by another speaker must not silently retract the source event
ambiguous repair must expose divergent graph outcomes
local scope event count should remain invariant when only the discourse target changes
